protocol.analysis: New post-hoc matched-initial-geometry anchor replacement control; offline only
protocol.cohort: Original 877 PartNet complete cases; one frozen intended parent edit each
protocol.intervention: Randomize both edge anchors, refit offsets to recover all original world OBBs, then apply frozen single-axis parent resize
protocol.seed_policy: For each object and seed, reset numpy.default_rng(seed); traverse original raw parts order; skip root; sample parent_anchor then child_anchor using uniform(-.5,.5,3), integers(0,3) face axis, random() >= .5 face sign
protocol.aggregation: Outgoing-edge absolute margin drifts averaged within object and seed, then five seeds averaged within object; equal object means
protocol.normalization: Original Anchor normalized frame fixed; no post-edit normalization
protocol.confidence_interval: 10,000 category-stratified paired percentile bootstrap replicates; seed 42; no p values
protocol.scope: Conditional on original geometry and orientations; offsets unconstrained after refitting; child-anchor randomness cancels from local outgoing-edge response for this task
